cursorTickTip: Default: 10 updates per second. Enter an integer from 1 to 30. Changes apply to all clients immediately. Higher rates use more bandwidth and power.
cursorTickFailed: Enter an integer from 1 to 30. Check that the kernel is connected and the workspace is writable, then retry.
cursorTickSaved: Cursor sync rate saved and applied to all clients.
kernelFailed: Collaboration status is unavailable. Check that the kernel plugin is running and retry.
restoreFailed: Could not restore this window's document. Check that it is still accessible and open it manually.
nameLabel: Name (1–24 characters, unique among online clients)
renameFailed: Use 1–24 valid characters and a name not already used by an online client.
editActivate: Click a block to request editing access. Press Esc to leave editing.
editLocked: ${name} is editing this block. You can select and copy text; wait for the edit lock to be released.
editPending: Requesting this block's edit lock. Please wait before typing.
editUnavailable: Edit locks cannot be verified. Editing is paused until the kernel reconnects.
historyChanged: The current block state differs from this history entry. Nothing was applied; open Personal undo history for details.
historyEmptyUndo: No personal edits to undo in this document in this window.
historyLocked: ${name} is editing a block needed by this operation. Retry after they leave editing; your record is retained.
historyEmptyRedo: No personal edits to redo in this document in this window.
historyUncertain: The commit result is uncertain. Retrying is paused. Refresh and check the document to avoid applying the change twice.
historyFailed: Undo/redo did not complete. Your record is retained. Check the kernel connection and retry.
historyUnavailable: Open a supported document editor to use personal undo.
historyUnsupported: This step cannot currently be replayed safely. Expand its record for the specific reason.
editFlushFailed: The last input is not confirmed saved. The edit lease has not been explicitly released. Check the kernel connection and save before retrying.
editInputCancelled: The input waiting for permission was cancelled. Please enter it again in the current block.
editReleaseFailed: The operation completed, but its edit lease could not be released. Check the connection; do not submit it again.
editMoveUnsupported: This drop needs a block conversion that personal undo cannot safely restore yet. No blocks were moved.
editMoveSameDocument: Drag blocks within the same document; cross-document moves are not supported yet.
historyListSession: Only this window and document. Cleared when the plugin reloads.
historyListOrder: Undo or redo in order. Expand an entry for affected blocks and its result.
historyListInactive: This document is closed or inactive. Return to it before undoing or redoing.
historyListRecordedDetail: This entry has not been undone. Content, position, and permission are checked when you act.
historyListUndoneDetail: This entry was undone and can be redone in sequence.
historyAttemptCancelled: Cancelled while waiting; this undo or redo was not applied.
historyReasonContent: Current content differs from this entry. Later edits or normalization may cause this; it does not identify who changed it. No content was overwritten.
historyReasonPosition: The parent or preceding block differs from this entry. No position was changed.
historyReasonMissing: An affected block no longer exists, so this operation could not be safely restored.
historyReasonExists: This entry expects a deleted block, but it currently exists. It was not overwritten.
historyReasonDocument: An affected block or position anchor is outside the original document. No cross-document change was made.
historyReasonAnchor: A sibling or parent needed to restore the position is missing; the destination cannot be verified.
historyReasonStructure: The block hierarchy changed or could not be fully resolved; it no longer matches this entry.
historyUnsupportedAction: The action “${action}” needs separate undo support; no changes were made.
historyUnsupportedData: The operation lacks a complete, valid block snapshot or inverse. It cannot be safely replayed.
historyUnsupportedLoaded: The blocks or restoration anchors needed to verify this operation were not fully loaded when recorded.
historyUnsupportedRoundTrip: Replaying the recorded inverse and original operations does not reproduce the current block content and order. This step was kept for inspection.
historyUnsupportedExternal: This step includes database or query-embed data that is not fully represented by block snapshots.
historyUnsupportedFoldMove: Moving a folded heading may also move hidden subordinate blocks; their complete inverse is unavailable.
historyUnsupportedSize: This step exceeds the verified personal-history size or block-count limit.
historyReasonAttributes: The attribute being restored has changed since this step. The current value was preserved.
historyUnsupportedAttributes: This attribute or its combination with structural changes is not yet supported by personal undo.
